exposure: Congenital heart disease (CHD) associated pulmonary hypertension (PH) severity (no PH, mild PH, moderate-to-severe PH)
outcome: Cardiac complications (e.g., heart failure, other cardiac complications)
cohort: The study included 2220 pregnant women with congenital heart disease who had completed pregnancies.
finding: Women with CHD-associated mild PH generally experience better maternal outcomes compared with those with moderate-to-severe PH, with outcomes for mild PH patients being similar to those with no PH for most measures.
